messages:
anya: Quick thread: finalizing export modal microcopy, presets conflict UX, and a11y announcements. Trying to avoid surprises for power users and screen-reader users. Sketch + checklist in Figma link below.
leo: Thanks. Two items I want to call out early: filename templating (user wants %dataset%_%date%) and how presets interact with manual overrides. We need clear labeling.
marcus: Agreed. For filename templating, propose a small preview under filename input that updates live: e.g., 'my-vectors_2026-03-23.csv'. Also add a help icon with examples and allowed tokens.
maria: On presets: when a user applies a preset and then changes a field, show a small badge next to the preset name: 'Modified'. Clicking it should open a mini diff showing the single changed setting.
devon: Accessibility: announce preset apply via aria-live polite: "Preset 'Compact CSV' applied. 1 setting modified." If user modifies a field, update the live region: "Local setting changed: delimiter set to Tab." Make sure screen reader users can clear to revert to preset.
anya: We also need to handle preset conflicts when multiple presets were saved with overlapping names. Suggest unique slug + show owner (workspace / personal) and a tooltip: 'Personal preset overrides workspace if same name'.
leo: Nice. Edge-case: what if workspace preset requires Parquet but user forced CSV via manual change? We should validate on download and surface a non-blocking warning: 'This preset typically uses Parquet for vector payloads; CSV may be very large. Continue?'
marcus: For progress & a11y: long exports should announce progress updates via aria-live at infrequent intervals (every 10% or when chunks finish) to avoid spamming. Example messages: 'Export in progress: 20% complete', 'Export complete. Download ready.' The download link should be focusable.
maria: Copy nits: header = 'Download vectors'; primary CTA = 'Download'; secondary = 'Apply (session)'; overflow = 'Save preset...'; filename label = 'Filename (preview below)'. Keep labels short.
devon: Keyboard flow: users can tab into filename, presets list, preview toggle, and export options. Shortcut: Alt+D to focus Download button (documented in tooltip). Also Esc closes modal, restoring focus to the export trigger.
anya: Per-row downloads: if a preset is active, per-row menu item reads 'Download row (ignores preset)'. Add a small confirmation on first use: 'This will ignore the active preset. Don't show again' checkbox.
leo: QA checklist additions: filename token expansion tests, preset ownership resolution, aria-live messages under load, and partial-failure handling (e.g., export fails at 60% with retry).
marcus: UX: show an estimated file size before download if possible and suggest Parquet when large. The estimate can be approximate: 'Estimated size: ~120MB'. If >100MB show a 'Consider Parquet' callout.
maria: Privacy/enterprise copy: footer small text 'Files are generated for your workspace and only leave Redwood if you download them.' Link to docs and compliance page.
aria-bot: figma: prototype at https://figma.com/file/preset-export-ux - updated 2026-03-24. protoversion: export-presets-v2.4
anya: Action items:
- Implement filename templating preview + help (marcus)
- Add 'Modified' badge + diff mini-panel when applied preset changed (maria)
- Aria-live phrasing and throttling for progress & changes (devon)
- Preset ownership display + conflict rules (leo)
- Estimated size + Parquet suggestion (marcus)
- First-use per-row confirmation checkbox (anya)
- Lock copy for modal labels (maria)
anya: Please react with :white_check_mark: when youre happy with copy and flow and I will sync with PMs for the dev ticket.
leo: :white_check_mark:
marcus: :white_check_mark:
maria: :white_check_mark:
